Hero.description: Jamila Sultan Welfare Society is committed to providing accessible healthcare, preventive medicine, and community welfare for underserved families across Pakistan.

AboutSection.title: Our Best Way Everyday
AboutSection.description: To build a healthy, educated, and empowered society where everyone has equal access to quality healthcare and welfare services. We are driven by compassion and the belief that healthcare is a fundamental human right.

features.professional_care_desc: Our team consists of qualified and experienced healthcare professionals dedicated to excellence.
features.compassionate_approach_desc: We treat every patient with empathy, respect, and dignity, ensuring they feel supported.
features.transparency_trust_desc: We maintain the highest standards of integrity and transparency in all our welfare activities.

ServicesSection.title: Healthcare Services
ServicesSection.description: We offer a wide range of medical services designed to meet the healthcare needs of our community, delivered with professionalism and care.

general.title: General Consultation
general.description: Expert medical advice and treatment from our qualified general physicians.

camps.description: Free medical camps in underserved communities providing essential healthcare.

womens_health.title: Women's Health
womens_health.description: Specialized care focusing on maternal health, gynecology, and well-being.

childrens_health.title: Children's Health
childrens_health.description: Comprehensive pediatric care from vaccinations to general treatments.

vaccination.title: Vaccination Center
vaccination.description: Immunization programs to protect against preventable diseases.

WhyChooseUs.title: Excellence in Healthcare & Welfare
WhyChooseUs.description: We stand apart through our unwavering commitment to providing high-quality, compassionate healthcare to those who need it most, without compromising on professional standards.
